name: Minimum
description: Advanced live toggle optimization for Geometry Dash. Parallel batch transforms, particle and streak culling, many settings. No restart needed to toggle.

mod-enabled.name: Enable Minimum
mod-enabled.description: Master switch. Toggle anytime in a level with no restart to compare FPS.

performance-mode.name: Performance Mode
performance-mode.description: Turns on the strongest combination of opts automatically.

skip-empty-batch.name: Skip Empty Batches
skip-empty-batch.description: Skip draw calls for sprite batches with zero quads.

parallel-batch.name: Parallel Batch Transforms
parallel-batch.description: Update sprite transforms on a thread pool before drawing large batches.

parallel-threshold.name: Parallel Threshold
parallel-threshold.description: Minimum child count before parallel transforms kick in.

fast-batch-sort.name: Fast Batch Sort
fast-batch-sort.description: Use stable_sort for large batch child reordering.

cull-particles.name: Cull Offscreen Particles
cull-particles.description: Skip update for particle systems far off screen.

cull-margin.name: Cull Margin
cull-margin.description: Screen margin in points before a particle system is treated as offscreen.

limit-particles.name: Limit Particle Count
limit-particles.description: Hard cap particles per system every frame.

particle-cap.name: Particle Cap
particle-cap.description: Max particles per system. Lower = more FPS.

reduce-emission.name: Reduce Particle Emission
reduce-emission.description: Scale down spawn rate to cut lag spikes.

emission-scale.name: Emission Scale
emission-scale.description: Spawn rate multiplier. 0.2 = 20 percent of normal.

skip-particle-draw.name: Skip Offscreen Particle Draw
skip-particle-draw.description: Do not draw offscreen particle systems.

cull-streaks.name: Cull Offscreen Streaks
cull-streaks.description: Skip motion streak update and draw when off screen.

fast-alt-tab.name: Fast Alt Tab
fast-alt-tab.description: Skip save when the game loses focus.

force-rgba8888.name: Force RGBA8888
force-rgba8888.description: Sharper textures. Windows only. Needs texture reload.

anti-aliasing.name: Anti Aliasing
anti-aliasing.description: MSAA 0 off to 4. Keep at 0 for max FPS while recording.
